title: GlobalX策略师：AI交易扩散，关注基建能源商品？
speaker: Billy Lung

segments.en: Well I think you know I think AI trades really really got breath now everyone I think yes you know AI trade have been driven by semiconductors I think a lot of things that people haven't been looking at is actually the peaks and shovels that go behind AI and it's not just your memories it's not just your GPUs or whatever it's also the infrastructure that goes behind it.
segments.zh: 我认为AI交易已经扩散。虽然半导体驱动，但人们忽视的是AI背后的“卖铲人”——不仅是存储和GPU，还有基础设施。

segments.en: You know what are the companies that are actually building the data centers you know this actually requires a lot of interconnect cables power equipment power cooling equipment optical cables which again is a very strong market in China right now and these are one of the key things that we've been looking at as well at the picks and shovels of who are the winners that's going to come out from this increased hyper scale of spending.
segments.zh: 建设数据中心的公司需要大量互联电缆、电源设备、冷却设备、光缆等，这些在中国市场非常强劲。我们关注这些“卖铲人”中的赢家。

segments.en: And I guess the third sort of layer things to look at is what are the energy and also commodities that go behind it when all the copper wire that goes into data center again something that we've been looking at very very strongly and even when you look at the energy is overall energy going to be powered by renewable resources such as uranium these are very much the derivatives that we need to look at when we consider the AI trade.
segments.zh: 第三层是能源和商品，比如数据中心用的铜线。我们也在关注能源是否由可再生能源（如铀）提供。这些都是AI交易的衍生机会。
